topics.purpose: Define deterministic machine-readable package contents, identities, versions, dependencies, hashes and declared install/export semantics.

semantics.identity_rule: Manifest belongs to one exact package identity/revision.
semantics.member_rule: Each package member has an exact logical path/identity/type.
semantics.hash_rule: Content integrity metadata is explicit per member where required.
semantics.order_rule: Archive member order never changes package semantics.
semantics.install_rule: Install targets/actions are declarative and separately validated.
semantics.unknown_rule: Unknown required manifest fields fail validation.

invariants.rule: Package, artifact, module, certification, license and installed-instance identities remain distinct; hashes prove content integrity only within their declared profile and never grant runtime authority.
License or certification entitlement permits declared product/service use only; it never substitutes for IAM identity, AccessCore authorization, runtime validation or dispatcher gating.
